children: Advent, FedEx, A&R and PPF completed their acquisition of InPost, which is now wholly owned by the consortium and delisted from Euronext Amsterdam. The consortium holds 37%, 37%, 16% and 10%, respectively.
The deal removes InPost from public trading, ending direct public-market exposure to the company.
Advent and FedEx each hold 37% of consortium
The two largest consortium stakes give each a significant ownership position in the privately held company.
These stakes complete the consortium ownership structure following closing.
InPost and FedEx entered arm's-length agreements
The agreements provide selected recipients access to InPost's European last-mile capabilities; broader commercial opportunities remain under exploration.

This is the closing of a previously announced acquisition, not a new operating-results disclosure. Further developments in the FedEx commercial arrangements or the consortium's investment and expansion plans would be needed to establish additional business impact.
Based on the original press release from InPost S.A. distributed by BusinessWire.
